title: fix(cli): os serve names an unloaded devPlugins entry by the list it was written in
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X1zG3Xn4JonaKvDLLr5gnjL)_

Refs #28284

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`os serve --dev` 因可能提供加密提供者的项没能加载而拒绝启动时，`devPlugins` 里的项现在点名为 `devPlugins[i]`，不再按它排在 `plugins` 之后的位置点名。判断是否拒绝的 `providesServices` 读取改为与 `cryptoProviderPlugins` 共用同一个判定，docstring 也写明了「声明其它服务或什么都没声明的项被排除」。
- **为什么改**：#31263 契约复审的 should-fix 2 与 3(should-fix 1 的 docstring 部分)。
- **风险与回滚**：只改 `@objectstack/cli`(patch)。哪些项会被拒绝不变，只改报错里的名称。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` 的 `declaresCryptoProvider`、`refuseUnloadedCryptoProviderPlugins` 的 label，以及栈插件循环 catch 里的 `list: 'devPlugins'`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project integration src/commands/serve-host-crypto-provider.test.ts test/serve-crypto-provider-plugin-load-failure.integration.test.ts`，预期 34/34。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位复审后落地。

## What changes

- **Refusal label.** `os serve` refuses to boot when an entry that may provide the crypto provider (`crypto-provider`) does not load. Under `--dev`, a `devPlugins` entry is now named `devPlugins[i]`, where it used to be named by its position after the stack's `plugins` (`plugins[plugins.length + i]`).
  - `UnloadedStackPlugin` gains an optional `list` (`'plugins' | 'devPlugins'`; absent means `plugins`).
  - The boot loop records it from the authored `plugins` length.
- **One reading of the declaration.** `refuseUnloadedCryptoProviderPlugins` reads `providesServices` through the predicate `cryptoProviderPlugins` filters by (`declaresCryptoProvider`), not through its own copy.
- **Docstring.** It now states the rule the code applies: an entry that declares other services, or declares none, is ruled out.

Which entries are refused is unchanged.

## Why

Follow-up to the contract review of #31263 (should-fixes 2 and 3, and the docstring half of 1).

## Verification

Readings on head `279bb7dca` (one commit on `main` at `9447f9552`).

- `serve-host-crypto-provider.test.ts`:
  - a unit case for the `devPlugins` label;
  - a case that refusal and `cryptoProviderPlugins` agree on a declaring entry, an entry declaring another service, and an entry declaring none;
  - the source pin now locates the record by `unloadedStackPlugins.push(`.
- Red-first: with `serve.ts` set back to its `main` blob, the two files read 2 failed | 32 passed (34). The two red cases were the `devPlugins` label unit case and the `--dev` boot. Restored (blob equal to HEAD): 34 passed (34).
